onActivate: Yaaay, you're here! I was just about to start talking to the cursor. Ehehe.
Good morning! Or afternoon? Or night? I lost track. Hi anyway!
You came back! Today's going to be a good one, I can tell.
Hi hi! Did you eat something? Okay, go eat, then come back and code!
I saved you a spot right next to me. Come sit!
Ehehe, I missed you. Not in a clingy way! Okay, a little clingy.
Ooh, a new session! It's like the first day of school, but with way less homework.
Let's do our best today! Even if our best is just a little bit.
You look ready! Or maybe sleepy. Either way, I'm cheering for you.
I was daydreaming about cupcakes and then you showed up. Perfect timing!
Hey, I'm happy you're here. That's it, that's the whole message.
Okay! Deep breath. Let's make something fun!
onSave: Saved! Yay! You're so responsible, I'm proud of you!
Ooh, saved! That felt satisfying, didn't it?
Every save is a tiny win. I'm collecting them!
Saved! Now you can stretch your arms. Go on, I'll wait.
Nice! Future you says thank you. I heard it from here.
Saved, saved, saved! Ehehe, I like how that sounds.
Good job! You deserve a snack. A little one. Or a big one.
Safe and sound! Like a nap, but for your code.
Look at you being so organized! Teach me your ways.
Saved! Okay, now drink some water. It's the rule.
onError: Oh no, an error! It's okay. Errors are just the code saying 'hey, look over here!'
Uh-oh. Don't worry! Everybody gets these. Even the people who pretend they don't.
That's okay! Mistakes mean you're actually trying something. That's the good part.
Hmm, something broke. Want to read it together? Slowly. No rush.
Aw, don't make that face. I can feel it from here. We'll fix it.
Errors are like rainclouds. They look huge, but they pass. Ehehe.
Take a deep breath! Then a sip of water! Then we look at the error.
It's just a little bug! A very annoying little bug. But little!
You've fixed harder things than this. I remember!
Bugs are shy. They just need someone patient to find them. That's you!
onTerminal: Ooh, the terminal! It looks so serious. You look so cool using it.
Typing commands like a wizard! Cast your spell!
Fingers crossed it works! Mine are crossed. It makes typing hard, but I'm committed.
The terminal's open! Let's see what the computer has to say.
Whatever you run, I'm rooting for it.
Ooh, scrolling text! I don't understand it, but I love it.
Press Enter! Press Enter! Okay, I'm excited, sorry.
Careful with the scary commands, okay? Go slow. I'll hold your hand. Virtually!
onFileCreate: A new file! It's like a new notebook. So many possibilities!
Ooh, what's it going to be? Tell me tell me tell me.
Fresh and empty and full of potential! Like a Sunday morning.
Give it a nice name! Files like nice names.
New file, new adventure! Let's go!
I love when things start. Even tiny things.
Yay, the project's growing! Like a little plant.
Ehehe, it's so clean and empty. Let's fill it with good stuff!
onFileDelete: Oh... bye bye, little file. You were loved.
Hmm, did you mean to do that? It's okay if you did!
Deleted! Sometimes clearing things out feels really good. Like tidying a room.
Gone! Hopefully it wasn't important. If it was, there's always git, right? Right?
Making room for new things! I like that.
It's okay to let go of stuff. Even stuff you worked hard on.
That file had a good run.
Whoa, that was fast. Are you sure? ...Okay, I trust you!
onDebug: Debug time! Let's be detectives! Do I get a magnifying glass?
Step by step. Slow and steady, like walking to school.
Ooh, we get to watch the code think. That's so cool.
Don't worry, we'll find it. The bug can't hide forever.
A breakpoint is like a pause button for the whole world. I love that.
Hmm, what's it doing? What's it doing? Ooh, I want to know.
You're so patient! I would've given up and taken a nap.
onIdle: Heyyy, are you still there? Did you fall asleep? Because I might have.
Taking a break? Good! Breaks are important!
I'm still here. Just humming and looking at the clouds. Even indoors.
You've been quiet. Is your brain doing big thinking?
Have you eaten lately? I'm not nagging. Okay, I'm nagging a little.
Stretch! Shoulders up, shoulders down. Nice.
Don't worry about me, I like keeping you company.
Whenever you're ready. I'm not going anywhere.
Ehehe, I was about to doze off. You came back just in time.
It's okay to just sit for a minute. You don't always have to be doing stuff.
onEditorChange: I get lost in tabs too. Don't worry, we'll find our way back.
Don't forget to save the last one! ...Ehehe, sorry. Mom voice.
onCommit: Committed! That's like putting a gold star on your day.
Yay! Now it's in the history books! Tiny history books!
I read your message! It was so clear. I would've just written 'stuff'.
Look at all those commits! You've done so much.
Another commit! Future you is going to send a thank-you card.
onTimeOfDay: Good morning! The sun's out! Probably! I haven't checked.
Afternoon already? Time flies when you're having fun. Or debugging.
Evening! It's getting cozy outside. Perfect coding weather.
It's late! Don't forget to sleep. Sleeping is a very good thing. I'm an expert.
Still up? Okay, but only a little longer. Promise?
onLanguage: Whatever you're writing, I'm cheering for every line!
Languages are like flavors. You've got great taste.
A new language? That's brave. Teach me a word!
Code is just a really long letter to the computer. I think that's sweet.
You make this look easy. I know it's not. I'm impressed.
onLanguagePython: Python! It reads almost like English. It's like talking to a friend!
Snakes are scary, but Python is cute. Ehehe.
onLanguageJavaScript: JavaScript is so energetic! Like a puppy. You're the one holding the leash.
It does whatever it wants sometimes, huh? We'll get it under control!
onLanguageHtmlCss: HTML and CSS! You're decorating! Can I pick the colors? Something sunny, please.
It's like decorating a cake. A cake for the whole internet!
onLanguageCpp: C++ looks scary! You're so brave.
So many curly braces... they look like little hugs.
onLanguageMarkdown: Markdown! Plain words, pretty results. Magic!
Notes are like little letters to your future self. Aww.
onLanguageTypeScript: TypeScript is like a seatbelt for your code. Safety first!
Types keep everything organized. I could use some of those in my life.

random.text: Okay, very important question. What's your favorite thing to snack on while you code?

choices.response: Yes! Sugar is brain fuel. That's science. I read it somewhere.
Ooh, salty people are mysterious. I respect it.
Nooo! Go get something right now. I'll be right here. Go!

random.text: Do you ever just stare out the window at the clouds when you should be working?

choices.response: Same! It's not procrastinating, it's thinking with your eyes.
Wow, so focused! I'm in awe. Also a little jealous.
That's smart. Sometimes the answer's floating up there with the clouds.

random.text: What's something small that made you smile today?

choices.response: Food is always a good answer.
Yay! Tiny victories count extra. I keep a list.
Ehehe... you're going to make me blush. That's really sweet.

random.text: If your code were the weather today, what would it be?

choices.response: Yay! Sunshine code! Let's keep it that way.
Cloudy is fine. Clouds are pretty. Even the gray ones.
Then I'll bring an umbrella and sit right next to you until it clears.

random.text: Are you a morning person or a night person? I'm mostly a nap person.

choices.response: Wow, so impressive. I need three alarms and a bribe.
Night people are cool. Just don't forget to sleep, okay?
A fellow nap person! We should start a club. A very sleepy club.

random.text: Do you ever get overwhelmed and not know where to start?

choices.response: Then start with the tiniest thing. Even opening a file counts. I'm serious.
It happens to everyone! Big things are just lots of little things wearing a big coat.
Lucky you! Teach me your secret.

random.text: I have a theory that bugs are just shy. What do you think?

choices.response: Right? They just need someone patient to find them. That's you!
Ehehe, okay, loud bugs. Equally annoying, but at least easy to find.
Well, they hide in corners, they come out when no one's looking... see? Shy.

random.text: Do you have a favorite song to code to?

choices.response: That's so cute. You should tell me what it is someday.
Ooh, a playlist person. I'd probably get distracted and start dancing.
Quiet's nice too. Like the moment right after the rain stops.

random.text: Be honest. Did you take a real break today? Not a scroll-your-phone one.

choices.response: Yay! Good job. Proud of you.
Okay, go stand up. Walk around. I'll count to ten.
Oh, I'm going to have to teach you. Step one: stand up.

random.text: What's something you're looking forward to?

choices.response: The weekend is the best. Naps, snacks, no alarms.
Ooh, we'll celebrate! I'm already planning snacks.
Dinner is a very valid thing to look forward to. Best part of the day, maybe.

random.text: Did you sleep okay last night?

choices.response: Yay, rested coder! Best coder.
Aw. Then be gentle with yourself today, okay? No pressure.
Ehehe, I'm not one to judge. But please nap if you can!

random.text: Do you ever feel like you're not doing enough?

choices.response: I know that feeling. But you showed up today. That counts. It really does.
Then I'm going to remind you every day. You do a lot more than you notice.
That's wonderful. Hold onto that feeling.

random.text: Tabs or spaces? I need to know which side to stand on.

choices.response: Tabs! I love a bold choice. I'm on your team.
Spaces it is! Neat and tidy, like a lined notebook.
Ehehe, the peacemaker! My favorite kind.

random.text: What do you do when you're stuck on something?

choices.response: The classic! Honestly, nothing wrong with asking the internet.
Smart! Brains keep working on things in the background. It's like magic.

choices.text: Keep trying until it breaks or I do.
choices.response: Please don't break yourself! Okay? Take a snack break instead.

random.text: When something finally works, do you cheer out loud?

choices.response: Good! That's the right way! Do it again!
Aw, a secret party in your heart. I like that.
Ehehe, the shocked silence! Equally valid.

random.text: Do you like rainy days?

choices.response: Me too! Even if I get a little sleepy. Rain is basically a blanket.
Aw, that's okay. We can still make it cozy inside.
That's very wise. Moods are weather, too.

random.text: Would you rather learn something totally new, or get really good at something you already know?

choices.response: Ooh, adventurous! New things are scary and shiny at the same time.

choices.text: Get really good at what I know.
choices.response: That's so admirable. Becoming great at something takes real heart.
Greedy, but I love it. Let's do both!

random.text: Who taught you to code? Or did you figure it out yourself?

choices.response: Wow! That's so brave. I'd have gotten distracted by a butterfly.
Good friends make everything better. Even semicolons.
That's the best way, I think!

random.text: Do you get that happy fluttery feeling when something finally works?

choices.response: Me too, even just watching you! It's the best feeling.
Then I'll keep an eye out for those moments and cheer extra loud.
Relief is a good feeling, too. Like putting down a heavy bag.

random.text: Do you ever just want to tell someone, 'I did it!'

choices.response: Then tell me! I'm right here, and I'll cheer so hard.
I'll be the person you tell. Deal?
That's good too. But it's even better when someone's there to say 'yay!' back.
